cleaning_actions: Parsed multi-line GuestNameList report blocks into one reservation-like provisional row per block.
Trimmed leading/trailing whitespace and collapsed repeated internal whitespace.
Converted arrival and departure dates from MM/DD/YYYY strings to ISO YYYY-MM-DD.
Converted numeric ID-like fields (confirmation_number, folio_number) to nullable integers.
Converted numeric metrics (rate, balance) to numeric types rounded to 2 decimals.
Normalized guest-name punctuation by removing escaped commas and backslash separators, trimming leading/trailing commas, and title-casing the resulting name tokens.
Normalized comments into single-line pipe-delimited text for CSV stability.
Standardized status labels to a canonical form when matched (Checked-Out, Cancelled, No-Show, Wait List).
Converted room_type and hold_type to uppercase after whitespace trimming.
Parsed CO/CU occupancy strings into co_count and cu_count when they matched N/N.
Deduplicated records using the cleaned reservation composite key documented in progress.md.
Within each duplicate group, kept the most complete record and filled its missing fields from duplicate copies when available.
remaining_known_issues: guest_name remains missing for many records because the raw report does not populate that field consistently in a dedicated column.
room_number remains missing for some cancelled or incomplete reservations.
comments are long PMS/export note blobs and were preserved in cleaned form rather than semantically parsed.
the cleaned dataset still contains PII fields (guest_name, email, free-text comments) and those should be removed or hashed before modeling.
